data.one_liner: AppBar that toggles into a search field with optional animations
data.what_it_does: Provides a replacement AppBar that can switch to a search mode, exposing callbacks for text changes, submission, and clearing. It supports custom animations and works with ValueNotifier or providers.
use_when: You need a search bar that stays in place without navigation changes
You want a lightweight, customizable AppBar with optional speech support
You prefer a widget that works with Stateless widgets and ValueNotifier
avoid_when: You need complex navigation or deep link handling
You require a full search bar with results list integration
strengths: Easy to integrate with a single required parameter
Works with Stateless widgets and ValueNotifier
weaknesses: Requires manual handling of search logic
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec and import package
